Landlord: I will let it fly this time…{{wi}} but don’t forget to prepare an additional 100$ for the next week too…{{wi}} and the next week after that. {{wi}} And the next week after that! And the next week after that! And the next week after that! 
You: W-What? Why?! Aren’t you just raising my rent?!
Landlord: You catch on quick. 
Landlord: It’s simple mathematics. Why wouldn’t I kick you out now, if I can within a week find someone who would pay 100$ more? There’s no charity in this business!
Landlord: Maybe now you will understand the importance of keeping your payment deadlines.
You: …
Landlord: See ya later, sucker!
#Landlord.animate(TransparencyTo0,0.5)
Damn it! He’s merciless! 
Hundred dollars more every week for missing one payment?! That’s a highway robbery!
I need to find a way to fight it back…
